messages.author: 96b7a8417e9b0c75
messages.subject: SEM - modindices
parts:
Hello,

I'm trying to model a multigroup SEM. The model results a 105.7Mb and I can't perform  a command like:

mod_ind7 <- modindices(M7)

It says: error: cannot allocate vector of size 955.3 Mb

I did many of the "cleaning memory" procedures but didn't work either: clean environment, restart R session with only 1 object, stop processes.

Any idea how to get the command working?

I'm using this version 0.5-23.1097

Thanks, Lucas

messages.author: 0325c6a976085eab
messages.subject: Re: SEM - modindices
parts:
This is an R problem - R is looking for a chunk of contiguous memory and it can't find it in your computer.  You might try rebooting your computer, and making sure you're not running any other programs (temporarily turn off your virus scanner, etc).

Alternatively, you can reduce the amount of memory needed. That's a big chunk of memory. Can you simplify your model or your data? E.g. if you're running MLR, run ML instead. If you've got missing data, do listwise deletion, don't use FIML. If your data set is large, resample it in half. 

Your modification indices should still be in the correct ballpark if you do those things, even if they're not identical.

Jeremy
